behaviors.description: Refresh and persist remote metadata from an independently published summary.
behaviors.preconditions: Configured remote points at a copied fixture repository; OSTree fixture tool publishes two distinct literal titles.
behaviors.expected: Before each refresh the title differs; update_remote_sync fetches the new title and a reopened installation retains it.

mappings.rationale: Independent summary mutations contrast stale configuration with refreshed and reopened title values.

surface_assertions.rationale: Each explicit refresh persists a different externally published title, verified on a new installation object.

notes: Only the copied fixture's public OSTree repository is edited; the target's installation layout is never inspected.
